metadata.summary: DeepLesion is a large-scale CT lesion dataset gathered from the NIH Clinical Center, containing 32,735 lesions across 32,120 axial CT slices from 4,427 patients, spanning various body parts (lung, liver, kidney, bone, etc.).
metadata.purpose: generic lesion detection, measurement, bounding-box regression

papers.title: DeepLesion: A Large-Scale and Diverse Database for Lesion Detection from CT

modality.scope: various body parts (lung, liver, kidney, bone, etc.)

ethics.legal_compliance: compliant with NIH Clinical Center data policies

extraction.notes: 基线卡仅来自 dataset_catalog.xlsx 真实元数据；其余字段需论文/README 或人工补充。
pending_verification: 以下 LLM 字段因不符合 schema 约束已自动丢弃并回退基线值，待人工核实：source_type, tasks_and_use/intended_tasks[list-items]

known_limitations: boxes derived from PACS bookmarks (RECIST), not full segmentation
bias_sources: label derivation from PACS bookmarks (not ground-truth pathology)
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: limited generalizability beyond NIH Clinical Center and US clinical CT practice

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: segmentation, classification without bounding box context

data_origin.selection_rationale: lesions gathered from PACS bookmarks (radiologist-measured marks) at NIH Clinical Center

population.target_population: patients undergoing CT imaging at NIH Clinical Center

annotation.annotation_method: bounding boxes with RECIST measurements mined from PACS bookmarks (radiologist-measured marks)
annotation.labeling_provenance: PACS bookmarks (radiologist-measured marks), not full segmentation masks
annotation.label_noise_description: boxes derived from PACS bookmarks (RECIST), not full segmentation; no per-lesion pathology confirmation
